bodyHTML:
Research question

How much does street-level air temperature differ from satellite land-surface temperature across neighbourhoods, and who is most exposed?

Project stage

Team forming

City or geography

Two mid-sized US cities

Available data and intended methods

Thirty low-cost sensors deployed for one summer, Landsat land-surface temperature, and census tract demographics. Mixed-effects models of the street–satellite gap.

Expertise needed

Someone with sensor calibration experience, and someone who knows exposure assessment in public health.

Time, output, and credit expectations

About two hours a week until March; a co-authored paper and an open dataset.

Relevant public links

No response

Research themes

Climate, Energy & Resilience, Urban Sensing & Spatial Data

Community agreement

  • I will follow the Code of Conduct
